contract: REQ-001
規則及測試以多組 SPEC ID、版本與 AC 編號驗證通用缺漏處理；不得依賴真實事件的固定 ID。
參數化流程測試及來源審查。
AC-001.rationale: Host owner/router/managed delivery behavior with isolated filesystem, negative authorization, continuity, interruption and package regression appropriate to this criterion.

contract: REQ-002
文件存於 specs/，有固定 ID、working 狀態、來源及候選與採用內容區別；回覆提供連結。
文件及 owner lifecycle 狀態檢查。
AC-002.rationale: Host owner/router/managed delivery behavior with isolated filesystem, negative authorization, continuity, interruption and package regression appropriate to this criterion.

contract: REQ-003
新工程討論有 working SPEC；每個已決定事項在相依後續步驟前保存在同一文件並可核對來源；候選不誤記為採用。
多回合 owner/router 測試與實際桌面 trace；保存失敗故障注入。
AC-003.rationale: Requires host owner/router tests plus real desktop hook event, omission/block/recovery evidence. Synthetic fixtures cannot establish actual host firing.

contract: REQ-004
持續多回合與恢復後討論均更新同一 SPEC；不限三回合，不因摘要或重啟另建文件；重複輸入不重複新增決定。
多回合數參數化序列、長序列及恢復測試。
AC-004.rationale: Host owner/router/managed delivery behavior with isolated filesystem, negative authorization, continuity, interruption and package regression appropriate to this criterion.

contract: REQ-005
有效授權可建立待完成申請；同申請重試不重複消耗來源，無授權／跨 task／跨 SPEC／跨版仍拒絕。
狀態與 CLI 行為測試。
AC-005.rationale: Host owner/router/managed delivery behavior with isolated filesystem, negative authorization, continuity, interruption and package regression appropriate to this criterion.

contract: REQ-006
無有效正式憑證但有目前授權且只有對照缺漏时可受限補齊；禁止範圍外寫入、降低要求、過期原檔或非確定性內容。
參數化完整流程及負向差異測試。
AC-006.rationale: Host owner/router/managed delivery behavior with isolated filesystem, negative authorization, continuity, interruption and package regression appropriate to this criterion.

contract: REQ-007
補齊後重新檢查全部條件，其他阻擋不核發；撤銷、重播、中斷、競態均保留正確權限與歷史。
故障注入、獨立預期狀態測試。
AC-007.rationale: Host owner/router/managed delivery behavior with isolated filesystem, negative authorization, continuity, interruption and package regression appropriate to this criterion.

contract: REQ-008
父 cwd 與子 repo 的 hook/router/owner 對到同 SPEC；多 repo 歧義與非法改綁拒絕且不另建。
暫存目錄 adapter 測試與路徑檢查。
AC-008.rationale: Host owner/router/managed delivery behavior with isolated filesystem, negative authorization, continuity, interruption and package regression appropriate to this criterion.

contract: REQ-009
已識別決定 A/B 只存 A 的摘要不能 PASS；完整逐項對照保存後可 PASS，候選不誤列採用。
owner/reconcile 行為測試、多回合 source 對照。
AC-009.rationale: Host owner/router/managed delivery behavior with isolated filesystem, negative authorization, continuity, interruption and package regression appropriate to this criterion.

contract: REQ-010, REQ-011
真實桌面 UserPromptSubmit/PreToolUse/Stop 攜帶正確 task/turn/root；刻意漏存可攔截受涵蓋操作，補存解除，無 loaded/fired 證據不假報。
真實桌面原始事件、候選雜湊、保存及攔截紀錄；模擬不替代。
AC-010.rationale: Requires host owner/router tests plus real desktop hook event, omission/block/recovery evidence. Synthetic fixtures cannot establish actual host firing.

contract: REQ-011
補存預算耗盡保留 unsaved，可讀／可修復／可回報；重啟不重置預算，實際輸入變更可重查。
程序中斷、重播、故障注入與狀態持久化測試。
AC-011.rationale: Host owner/router/managed delivery behavior with isolated filesystem, negative authorization, continuity, interruption and package regression appropriate to this criterion.

contract: REQ-012
舊資料可讀，既有授權與修復回歸通過，組裝來源一致且缺少桌面證據時保留整體驗收阻擋。
既有整合測試、layout、組裝與發佈包驗證。
AC-012.rationale: Host owner/router/managed delivery behavior with isolated filesystem, negative authorization, continuity, interruption and package regression appropriate to this criterion.
